title: George Carlin on Soft Language
summary: A George Carlin stand-up bit from Doin' It Again about soft language and euphemism, showing how softened words hide uncomfortable facts. It touches on topics like shell shock and aging.
why: Cited whenever euphemisms appear in corporate, product or news language, as the classic comedic critique.

quote.text: I refer you to George Carlin [1], who explained it better than I could.
